headline: Hershey Warns Gasoline Prices and Inflation Hurt Candy Sales
summary: The Hershey Company warned that consumer caution driven by inflation and elevated gasoline prices is reducing convenience store sales ahead of Halloween.
why: Hershey is a prominent US confectionery maker. Convenience store checkout data provides early signals of consumer discretionary spending behavior among lower- and middle-income demographics.

impacts.name: The Hershey Company
impacts.why: Weaker convenience store sales were reported as consumers cut back in response to gas prices and inflation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
